employers.careersSnapshot: On 2026-11-07 the public Figma careers page linked to job posts on https://boards.greenhouse.io/figma, including Distribution Partner Manager (job 5813967004). ProofRoute treats the Greenhouse board token figma as Figma's employer-linked route. This text is a reviewed snapshot. A check does not refetch the careers page. This is not a partnership, endorsement, or statement about any recruiter.

provenance.note: The Greenhouse API absolute_url host was boards.greenhouse.io. The earlier TRD seed used job-boards.greenhouse.io. ProofRoute recommends only the host returned by the API after an allowlist check.
